name: Badge
description: A small inline label rendered as a rounded-full pill with color-coded variants. Uses class-variance-authority (CVA) for variant management. Includes both shadcn legacy variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline) and Traxion-specific color variants (primary, green, yellow, red, gray, cyan, violet, blue, teal, orange, pink, fuchsia).

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style variant of the badge. Legacy shadcn variants use solid backgrounds with hover states. Traxion variants use a colored border and text with a 10% opacity background.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn().

accessibility.role: Renders as a div element. No implicit ARIA role. If the badge conveys status information, consider adding role='status' or an aria-label.
accessibility.keyboard: Not interactive by default. Supports focus ring styles via focus:ring-2 for cases where it is made focusable.
accessibility.aria: No built-in ARIA attributes. Add aria-label if the badge color alone conveys meaning that is not reflected in the text content.
accessibility.notes: Color should not be the only means of conveying information. Ensure badge text provides sufficient context.

recommendations.description: No colocar íconos dentro de un badge. El badge debe ser pequeño y simple. Incluir íconos puede hacerlo parecer un botón o un componente de acción.
